title: Transcription Factors: Pooled, Growth-Based Assays
author: David Ross
materials: Add 400 mL M9-gly into a 500mL sterile media bottle.

Notes: Important reagent handling considerations. Use DMSO handling precautions for ligand and antibiotic stocks. TMP is sensitive to freeze/thaw cycles, so do not use a TMP stock aliquot for more than one experiment. Throw away any leftover TMP after creating the TMP solutions described in this section. Vanillic acid is light sensitive, so cover any Vanillic acid solution in foil when not in use. Final concentrations of inducers created in this section (2x higher than used in the growth plates): LacI's inducer: 4000 umol/L IPTG RamR's inducer: 500 umol/L 1S-TIQ VanR's inducer: 200 umol/L Vanillic acid Final concentrations of selection antibiotic (Trimethoprim or TMP) created in this section (10x higher than used in the growth plates) for all transcription factors: Low TMP: 3 ug/mL Medium TMP: 10 ug/mL High TMP: 30 ug/mL
Add 400 uL kanamycin (kan) to the M9-gly media and mix well.
Create 25 mL of 1S-TIQ at 500 umol/L using the following steps:
Pipette 24.875 mL M9-gly-kan (without DMSO) into the Falcon tube.
Create 25mL of TMP at 30 ug/mL stock using the following sub-steps. Note: Use only new TMP freezer stocks; multiple freeze-thaw cycles will degrade the TMP.
Mix by pipetting up and down
Add 125 uL 1S-TIQ freezer stock (100 mmol/L in DMSO) to the falcon tube
Label a 50mL falcon tube "1S-TIQ at 500 umol/L "
Label a 50mL falcon tube "TMP at at 30 ug/mL - High TMP solution "
Pipette 24.875 mL M9-gly-kan (without DMSO) into a Falcon tube
Add 95 uL DMSO to the flacon tube.
Mix by pipetting up and down.
Add 30 uL TMP freezer stock (previously prepared at 25 mg/mL in DMSO)

Mix and rinse pipette tip by pipetting up and down. Note: This solution is the highest TMP concentration used in the experiment and will be used in subsequent steps to create the medium and low TMP solutions.
Create M9-gly-Kan media using the following sub-steps.
Create the working media by adding DMSO to the remaining M9-gly-kan media using the following sub-steps.
Add 1.76 mL DMSO to M9-gly-kan media bottle.
Mix well. Note: This solution is now the working media that will be referred to throughout the rest of this protocol.
Prepare 15 mL of the low and medium TMP solutions using the following sub-steps.

Create the low TMP solution (3 ug/mL TMP): Label a 50 mL falcon tube 'Low TMP solution' Add 13.5 mL working media media into the flacon tube. Add 1.5 mL of the 30 ug/mL TMP stock (i.e., the high TMP solution). Mix by pipetting up and down.

Create the medium TMP solution (10 ug/mL TMP): Label a 50 mL falcon tube 'Medium TMP solution' Add 10 mL working media media into the flacon tube. Add 5 mL of the 30 ug/mL TMP stock (i.e., the high TMP solution). Mix by pipetting up and down.
Prepare 25 mL of 4000 umol/L of IPTG.
Pipette 24.9 mL M9-gly-kan (with DMSO) into Falcon tube
Add 100 uL IPTG freezer stock (1 mol/L in water).
Mix and rinse pipette tip by pipetting up and down.
Labeled a 50mL falcon tube "IPTG at 4000 umol/L"
Prepare 25 mL of 200 umol/L Vanillic Acid Reminder: Vanillic acid is light sensitive, so cover any Vanillic acid solution in foil when not in use.
Pipette 24.95 mL of the working media into the Falcon tube
Add 50 uL Vanillic acid freezer stock (100 mmol/L in ethanol)

steps.title: Prepare Overnight Growth Media
steps.instruction: Prepare M9-gly-kan media by adding kanamycin stock to M9-gly media.

substeps.instruction: Prepare a 200 mL capacity flask: add 150 mL M9-gly Media and 150 µL kanamycin stock (50 mg/mL) to achieve 50 µg/mL kanamycin.
Prepare a 500 mL capacity flask: add 500 mL M9-gly Media and 500 µL kanamycin stock (50 mg/mL) to achieve 50 µg/mL kanamycin.
Mix both well.

steps.title: Start Overnight Cultures
steps.instruction: Inoculate variant libraries, normalization variants, and calibration variants using glycerol stocks.

substeps.instruction: For each of the three variant libraries (LacI, RamR, VanR), add 100 mL M9-gly-kan media to a 250 mL baffled flask and inoculate with one aliquot of glycerol stock. Close with an appropriate cap.
For normalization variants (pLacI-norm-02 and pRamR-norm-02), add 5 mL M9-gly-kan media to separate 14 mL snap-cap tubes and inoculate with a scraping from glycerol stock. Loosely cap tubes.

For calibration variants (LacI: 9 variants; RamR: 11 variants; VanR: 4 variants), add 5 mL M9-gly-kan media to 22 separate 14 mL snap-cap tubes and inoculate each with a scraping from its glycerol stock. Loosely cap tubes.

steps.title: Incubate Overnight Cultures
steps.instruction: Incubate all normalization, calibration, and library cultures overnight.

substeps.instruction: Incubate at 37°C with shaking at 300 rpm for 16-17 hours.

steps.title: Prepare Working Media for Pooled Cultures
steps.instruction: Prepare M9-gly-kan media supplemented with 1% DMSO.

substeps.instruction: Option 1: Add 40 mL M9-gly Media, 40 µL kanamycin stock (50 mg/mL), and 404 µL DMSO to a 50 mL flacon tube. Mix by pipetting.
Option 2: Add 75 mL M9-gly Media, 75 µL kanamycin stock (50 mg/mL), and 0.758 mL DMSO to a sterile media bottle (>100 mL capacity). Mix well.

steps.title: Pool Cultures and Grow for One Doubling
steps.instruction: Combine library and calibration cultures in baffled flasks and grow for one additional doubling.

substeps.instruction: Prepare one 250 mL sterile baffled flask per library (LacI, RamR, VanR) and add 25 mL of working media (M9-gly-kan with 1% DMSO).
Pour all corresponding calibration variant cultures into the respective library flask (8 for LacI, 10 for RamR, 4 for VanR; 22 total) and mix well.
Add 0.25 mL of each normalization variant (pLacI-norm-02 and pRamR-norm-02) to each of the three library flasks.
Add 0.5 mL of the pooled calibration variant culture to each library flask.
Add 24 mL of the corresponding variant library culture to its respective flask.
Incubate flasks at 37°C with shaking at 300 rpm for 5-7 hours.

steps.title: Load Automation System
steps.instruction: Prepare the liquid handler with media, reagents, and cultures.

substeps.instruction: Load a single cavity media reservoir (with lid) with ~200 mL M9-gly-kan-DMSO working media.
Load a single cavity waste reservoir (without lid) with ~100 mL tap water.
Fill a 6-column reservoir plate (with lid) as follows: Col 1: IPTG (4000 µmol/L); Col 2: IS-TIQ (500 µmol/L); Col 3: Vanillic acid (200 µmol/L); Col 4: low TMP; Col 5: medium TMP; Col 6: high TMP.
Load Growth Plate 1.
Load the three pooled library cultures (LacI, RamR, VanR) into separate labeled 60 mL reagent reservoirs with lids.

steps.title: Perform Growth QC Check
steps.instruction: Verify the OD600 of the pooled cultures before plating.

substeps.instruction: Dilute a sample of each pooled culture 10x (e.g., 100 µL culture + 900 µL M9-gly-kan) into a 1 cm cuvette or 96-well plate.
Measure OD600; expected range for 10x dilution is 0.3 to 0.8.

steps.title: Prepare and Incubate Growth Plate 1
steps.instruction: Seed the first growth plate and incubate to stationary phase.

substeps.instruction: Pipette 450 µL working media into each well of Growth Plate 1.
Pipette 50 µL of the appropriate pooled library + control culture into each well per the plate map.
Apply gas-permeable seal and incubate for 12 hours at 37°C with fastest shaking (e.g., Biotek Neo2: double orbital, 807 cpm, 1 mm diameter).
Measure OD600 and fluorescence every 5 minutes.

steps.title: Prepare and Seed Growth Plate 2
steps.instruction: Prepare the second plate with inducers and transfer cells from Plate 1.

substeps.instruction: Prepare Growth Plate 2 with 490 µL mixed media (working media + inducers) per well. Rows A, C, E, G: A1-A4 (240 µL media + 250 µL IPTG), A5-A8 (240 µL media + 250 µL IS-TIQ), A9-A12 (240 µL media + 250 µL Vanillic Acid). Rows B, D, F, H: 490 µL media.
Pre-warm Plate 2 to 37°C (e.g., Hamilton Heater-Cooler at 67°C for 10 mins) ending exactly when Plate 1 incubation finishes.

Remove seal from Plate 1 and transfer 10 µL from each well to the corresponding well in Plate 2 using a 96-channel head (specific mixing/aspiration parameters: 300 µL tips, 1 mm depth, 200 µL mix at 250 µL/s, aspirate 200 µL at 100 µL/s, dispense 200 µL at 120 µL/s, then aspirate 10 µL at 100 µL/s and dispense 3 mm below surface at 120 µL/s).
Apply gas-permeable seal and incubate for 2 hours 45 minutes at 37°C with fastest shaking. Measure OD600 and fluorescence every 5 minutes.

steps.title: Prepare and Seed Growth Plate 3
steps.instruction: Prepare the third plate with inducers and TMP, then transfer cells from Plate 2.

substeps.instruction: Prepare Growth Plate 3 with 450 µL mixed media (working media + inducers + TMP). Volumes for Row A: A1 (225 µL media + 225 µL IPTG), A2 (175 µL media + 50 µL low TMP + 225 µL IPTG), A3 (175 µL media + 50 µL med TMP + 225 µL IPTG), A4 (175 µL media + 50 µL high TMP + 225 µL IPTG), A5 (225 µL media + 225 µL IS-TIQ), A6 (175 µL media + 50 µL low TMP + 225 µL IS-TIQ), A7 (175 µL media + 50 µL med TMP + 225 µL IS-TIQ), A8 (175 µL media + 50 µL high TMP + 225 µL IS-TIQ), A9 (225 µL media + 225 µL Vanillic Acid), A10 (175 µL media + 50 µL low TMP + 225 µL Vanillic Acid), A11 (175 µL media + 50 µL med TMP + 225 µL Vanillic Acid), A12 (175 µL media + 50 µL high TMP + 225 µL Vanillic Acid). Row B: B1 (450 µL media), B2 (400 µL media + 50 µL low TMP), B3 (400 µL media + 50 µL med TMP), B4 (400 µL media + 50 µL high TMP), B5 (450 µL media), B6 (400 µL media + 50 µL low TMP), B7 (400 µL media + 50 µL med TMP), B8 (400 µL media + 50 µL high TMP), B9 (450 µL media), B10 (400 µL media + 50 µL low TMP), B11 (400 µL media + 50 µL med TMP), B12 (400 µL media + 50 µL high TMP). Rows C, E, G same as A; D, F, H same as B.
Pre-warm Plate 3 ten minutes before Plate 2 incubation ends.
Remove seal from Plate 2 and transfer 50 µL from each well to Plate 3 using the 96-channel head method.
Apply gas-permeable seal and incubate for 2 hours 45 minutes at 37°C with fastest shaking. Measure OD600 and fluorescence every 5 minutes.

steps.title: Prepare and Seed Growth Plate 4
steps.instruction: Prepare the fourth plate and transfer cells from Plate 3.

substeps.instruction: Prepare Growth Plate 4 with 450 µL mixed media (working media + inducers + TMP). Volumes for Row A: A1 (225 µL media + 225 µL IPTG), A2 (180 µL media + 45 µL low TMP + 225 µL IPTG), A3 (180 µL media + 45 µL med TMP + 225 µL IPTG), A4 (180 µL media + 45 µL high TMP + 225 µL IPTG), A5 (225 µL media + 225 µL IS-TIQ), A6 (180 µL media + 45 µL low TMP + 225 µL IS-TIQ), A7 (180 µL media + 45 µL med TMP + 225 µL IS-TIQ), A8 (180 µL media + 45 µL high TMP + 225 µL IS-TIQ), A9 (225 µL media + 225 µL Vanillic Acid), A10 (180 µL media + 45 µL low TMP + 225 µL Vanillic Acid), A11 (180 µL media + 45 µL med TMP + 225 µL Vanillic Acid), A12 (180 µL media + 45 µL high TMP + 225 µL Vanillic Acid). Row B: B1 (450 µL media), B2 (405 µL media + 45 µL low TMP), B3 (405 µL media + 45 µL med TMP), B4 (405 µL media + 45 µL high TMP), B5 (450 µL media), B6 (405 µL media + 45 µL low TMP), B7 (405 µL media + 45 µL med TMP), B8 (405 µL media + 45 µL high TMP), B9 (450 µL media), B10 (405 µL media + 45 µL low TMP), B11 (405 µL media + 45 µL med TMP), B12 (405 µL media + 45 µL high TMP). Rows C, E, G same as A; D, F, H same as B.
Pre-warm Plate 4 ten minutes before Plate 3 incubation ends.
Remove seal from Plate 3 and transfer 50 µL from each well to Plate 4 using the 96-channel head method.
Apply gas-permeable seal and incubate for 2 hours 45 minutes at 37°C with fastest shaking. Measure OD600 and fluorescence every 5 minutes.

steps.title: Prepare and Seed Growth Plate 5
steps.instruction: Prepare the fifth plate and transfer cells from Plate 4.

substeps.instruction: Prepare Growth Plate 5 with 450 µL mixed media using the same volumes as for Growth Plate 4.
Pre-warm Plate 5 ten minutes before Plate 4 incubation ends.
Remove seal from Plate 4 and transfer 50 µL from each well to Plate 5 using the 96-channel head method.
Apply gas-permeable seal and incubate for approximately 2 hours 45 minutes at 37°C with fastest shaking. Measure OD600 and fluorescence every 5 minutes.

steps.title: Extract Plasmid DNA
steps.instruction: Combine replicate wells from each timepoint and extract plasmid DNA.

substeps.instruction: For each timepoint (1 through 4), combine 4 replicate wells from each condition into a single well of a polypropylene deep well plate.
Run the plasmid DNA extraction protocol. Label as 'time point 1' (from Plate 2), 'time point 2' (from Plate 3), 'time point 3' (from Plate 4), and 'time point 4' (from Plate 5).
Elute DNA using nuclease-free water if BarSeq prep is immediate; otherwise, use EB buffer or TE-4 to avoid low pH degradation.
Store extracted DNA at 4°C.
